description: This PHP class defines a template component for a drag-and-drop chooser UI element within the SuiteCRM platform. It extends a base Template class and provides methods to generate HTML, JavaScript, and associated scripts for rendering and manipulating a multi-column draggable grid interface used for selecting or organizing items.

classes.name: TemplateDragDropChooser
classes.description: A PHP class providing rendering and scripting logic for a drag-and-drop multi-column chooser UI component in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML and inline JavaScript to display the drag-and-drop grid interface, based on configuration arguments.

methods.name: displayDefinitionScript
methods.description: Provides JavaScript class definitions and initialization code for the drag-and-drop grid component, based on configuration arguments.

methods.name: displayScriptTags
methods.description: Returns necessary external CSS and JavaScript tags required for the drag-and-drop component to function.
